strategy.when: Friendly defense commitment or unsupported red engagement observed
strategy.intervention: Preserve validated blue critical defense; test one bounded red entry/support change
strategy.reject_if: Same deaths delayed, defense stall, or regression to blue/field
strategy.observability: own-policy public host fields and permitted memory; no private Richard mode input

strategy.when: Visible Richard hero sieging exposed friendly tower; own healthy actor can attack within Richard range
strategy.intervention: One healthy actor attracts retaliation with allied damage support
strategy.reject_if: Rare activation, attacker killed faster, or no tower/match benefit
strategy.observability: own-policy public host fields and permitted memory; no private Richard mode input

strategy.when: Public Richard home-guard loss/critical state and visible intruder opportunity
strategy.intervention: Compare timed second-angle pressure during an observed nearest-defender return
strategy.reject_if: Diversion consolidates defense or costs more resources than it gains
strategy.observability: own-policy public host fields and permitted memory; no private Richard mode input

strategy.when: Visible hit/cast/approach events in a losing engagement
strategy.intervention: Measure cadence and ring impacts before changing approach or recovery
strategy.reject_if: No actual exploitable window or movement cancels own windups
strategy.observability: own-policy public host fields and permitted memory; no private Richard mode input

strategy.when: Visible early Ranger with limited equipment and a supported engagement opportunity
strategy.intervention: Test bounded coordinated pressure and fewer repeated isolated hero deaths
strategy.reject_if: Early XP gain disappears, own farm/core sacrificed, or Ranger catches up and wins
strategy.observability: own-policy public host fields and permitted memory; no private Richard mode input

validation_plan.local: exact authentic Richard source with all ten VMs responding
validation_plan.hosted: fresh candidate/control XP, exact UUID, both colors; preserve already frozen session gates
validation_plan.independence: report distinct trajectories; repeated fixed-roster games are not independent trials
